verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Datadog ships an official CLI (datadog-ci on GitHub), so the core capability exists. However, the pack has only a single pointer to it, with no detail on scope, commands, or agent-friendly use. Missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage beyond the repo pointer, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
